hero.lede: CanopyX turns application data into searchable tree grids and sortable data tables. Write the view in C# and save a report that opens from disk or a file share, or mount the same runtime in your web app with npm.

facts.title: Virtual rows
facts.body: Only the rows on screen are in the page, so trees with more than 100,000 nodes stay responsive.

facts.title: Keyboard navigation
facts.body: Both views move with the arrow keys, Home and End, and expose tree and grid roles to assistive technology.

facts.title: No runtime dependencies
facts.body: Neither the NuGet packages nor the npm package add third-party runtime dependencies.

facts.title: Four languages built in
facts.body: English labels, plus Polish, German and Spanish packs for every control.

delivery.title: Single HTML file
delivery.body: Data and runtime in one page. Attach it to a ticket, archive it with a report, or open it straight from disk.

delivery.title: Sidecar bundle
delivery.body: The page loads branches and search shards from files next to it, so very large trees open from a file share with no server.

delivery.title: Hosted data
delivery.body: Your application serves pages, search results and counts. Paged and cursor-based sources keep large record sets on the server.

family.name: ChartForgeX
family.body: Charts, topology and report visuals rendered in .NET, for the pictures next to your tables.

family.name: HtmlForgeX
family.body: HTML reports and dashboards in C#. Its HtmlForgeX.CanopyX bridge hosts CanopyX views.

family.name: OfficeIMO
family.body: Export the same records to Excel, Word or PDF from your host application.

family.name: CodeGlyphX
family.body: QR codes and barcodes in pure .NET for asset labels and inventory tags.

surfaces.name: .NET
surfaces.body: Build views from your objects with CanopyX.Html on NuGet, net472 to net10.

surfaces.name: JavaScript
surfaces.body: Mount the same runtime from @evotecit/canopyx, with TypeScript types.

surfaces.name: Single file
surfaces.body: Data and runtime in one HTML page you can attach, archive or open from disk.

surfaces.name: File share
surfaces.body: Sidecar bundles load branches on demand, with no server behind them.

surfaces.name: Email and print
surfaces.body: Script-free tables from the same view for mail, print and Word.

showcases.title: File explorer
showcases.body: A share audit with sizes, owners, states, change badges and version history.

showcases.title: Device inventory
showcases.body: Grouping, facets, status strips, progress and sparklines in one reporting grid.
